title: Durable Electronic Payment Confirmation Persistence
purpose: Authoritative immutable durable recording of one validated FOOD-005F electronic payment confirmation against one exact durable FOOD physical-order version. Authority concerns recorded evidence and its order binding only; persistence does not authenticate the external payment assertion.

food005f.role: Canonical confirmation identity, immutable value validation and validateFoodElectronicPaymentConfirmationAgainstOrder. Initial creation requires version 1; there is no revision API.

food005i.role: Separate cash family; preserve and do not consume or persist cash evidence here.

food005k.role: Pure reconciliation precedent only. Its transient normalized snapshots do not become a generic durable payment entity.

food008a.role: Existing immutable parent table and created/already-present/conflict/invalid/storage-failure naming precedent.

food008b.role: Direct exact durable order authentication dependency; never replace with caller-owned order snapshots.

food007y.role: Authenticate durable parent before recording evidence; uncertain INSERT RETURNING responses resolve through one exact reread. No reservation semantics are imported.

artifacts.currentAuthorization: Create this specification only, unstaged. Migration, source and test must not be created in the contract-definition task.

publicApi.databaseSurface: Repository-standard injected prepare(sql).bind(...values).all<T>() success/results surface, structurally compatible with FOOD-008B. Private reads and one INSERT RETURNING only; no batch, exec, transaction or public read API.
publicApi.resultShape: Readonly discriminated union with outcome. created and already-present carry value; conflict, invalid and storage-failure carry no evidence or D1 metadata.
publicApi.readApi: Deferred to a later exact durable read unit; private persistence reads are not public retrieval authority.

candidateAuthentication.versionReason: FOOD-005F createInitialFoodElectronicPaymentConfirmationVersion requires 1. General positive-version validation does not establish revision semantics. Every other confirmation version is invalid here.
candidateAuthentication.hostileShape: Before invoking domain validation, capture a detached candidate using exact own data-property descriptors at every record level. Require plain Object.prototype or null-prototype records; reject arrays, accessors, symbols, inherited field substitutes, missing/extra keys, custom prototypes and throwing inspection without invoking getters or coercion hooks. This is boundary shape protection, not a duplicate domain validator.
candidateAuthentication.captureTiming: Validate and detach the full candidate before the first await. Caller mutation while a durable read is pending must not change the requested identity, order binding or evidence.
candidateAuthentication.canonicalIdentity: Use FOOD-005F identity parsing and canonical domain reconstruction. Reject any original identity/text/number representation that differs from its canonical captured value; do not coerce or repair.

orderAuthentication.model: B: perform FOOD-008B exact durable read directly on the injected database before accepting persistence, including idempotent replays.
orderAuthentication.found: Pass the captured complete confirmation and the authenticated durable order to validateFoodElectronicPaymentConfirmationAgainstOrder. Require exact order ID, version and merchandise subtotal currency/minorUnits equality.
orderAuthentication.not-found: conflict; the structurally valid candidate has no established exact durable parent. Zero writes. Do not add an order-not-established outcome or infer that payment failed.
orderAuthentication.invalid: invalid; unsupported or malformed exact order lookup coordinates. Zero writes.
orderAuthentication.storage-failure: storage-failure; no evidence write and no fallback.
orderAuthentication.candidateOrderMismatch: conflict when a valid candidate differs from an authenticated valid order, including subtotal mismatch. Malformed or wrong-coordinate durable rows remain FOOD-008B storage-failure.
orderAuthentication.cancelledOrder: Allow exact cancelled version 2 as FOOD-005F does. Record historical evidence without reviving order version 1 or implying release, reversal, refund or fulfillment permission.
orderAuthentication.reservationBinding: Separate. No 007Z read or reservation-acceptance field is required for recording this occurrence.

durableModel.reason: The complete FOOD-005F shape is small and consists of identity/version, exact order context, money and opaque references. Explicit columns support primary identity and relational constraints without redundant snapshot JSON or a serialization-format column.
durableModel.money: Preserve each canonical FoodMoney independently: uppercase three-letter currency and primitive nonnegative safe-integer minorUnits. Confirmed amount need not equal merchandise subtotal, and FOOD-005F does not require the two currencies to match. Do not introduce either equality constraint here; reconciliation has its own currency/amount gates.

referenceUniqueness.decision: Deferred explicitly: opaque processor/payment/source strings have no established account, merchant, environment or event namespace. Do not invent provider-global or processor-scoped uniqueness. Migration 0009 enforces only confirmation primary identity, not reference uniqueness.
referenceUniqueness.consequence: Different confirmation identities may retain equal processor/payment or source references. created/already-present proves identity-level durable recording only, not that money has not been represented by another confirmation. Downstream reference identity/deduplication must be contracted before authoritative aggregation.
referenceUniqueness.notAnEventId: Do not reinterpret confirmationSourceReference as a dedicated provider event ID.

privateReadsAndAuthentication.exactLookup: SELECT all 12 durableModel columns FROM food_electronic_payment_confirmations WHERE confirmation_id = ? AND confirmation_version = ? LIMIT 2. Static parameterized SQL; no ORDER BY, MAX, list/history or secondary reference lookup.
privateReadsAndAuthentication.envelope: Require trustworthy own success exactly true and own results array using hostile-boundary protections. Missing/uncertain envelopes, prepare/bind/all exceptions, sparse/accessor row slots, hostile rows or impossible cardinality are storage-failure.
privateReadsAndAuthentication.cardinality: Zero rows means absent privately; one row must authenticate; more than one is storage-failure, never choose the first.
privateReadsAndAuthentication.storedRow: Require exactly the 12 plain own-data-property columns, no accessors/symbols/inherited/missing/extra fields, canonical primitive values and exact requested confirmation coordinates. Reconstruct a fresh complete FOOD-005F object, validate it and enforce confirmation version 1 and supported order coordinates. Any unsafe stored shape or domain-invalid content is storage-failure. A structurally canonical divergent row is sufficient to reject the candidate as conflict; this does not claim that divergent row is authenticated payment authority. Before any success, require content equality and validate the matching value against the already-authenticated exact durable order.
privateReadsAndAuthentication.noSilentNormalization: Compare every stored column strictly against its validator-produced canonical mapped value. Domain parse/validation must not normalize malformed stored content into accepted durable truth.
privateReadsAndAuthentication.contentEquality: Compare all canonical FOOD-005F fields, including identity, exact order/subtotal, channel, both references, processor and confirmed money. Object identity is not content equality. A valid authentic existing record with the requested confirmation identity but different candidate content is conflict; a malformed stored record is storage-failure.

outcomeSemantics.created: An absent exact confirmation identity was inserted once, exactly one returned row authenticates against the durable order and equals the captured canonical candidate.
outcomeSemantics.already-present: An authenticated exact durable row equals every canonical candidate field, either during initial lookup or one post-insert recovery reread. No claim of processor/event deduplication is made.
outcomeSemantics.conflict: A valid exact durable identity contains different authentic canonical content, or the valid candidate lacks its exact durable order or mismatches that order/subtotal. Do not overwrite, retarget or relabel as payment rejection.
outcomeSemantics.invalid: Malformed/hostile candidate, unsupported confirmation version, unsupported exact order coordinates or domain validation failure before durable relationship comparison. No write.
outcomeSemantics.storage-failure: Order read fails authentication, storage operation throws, durable content/envelope/cardinality is unsafe, or an uncertain write cannot be classified by one exact reread. No fabricated success.

appendAlgorithm: Strictly capture, validate and detach the candidate; require confirmation version 1 before D1 access.
Authenticate its exact durable order using FOOD-008B and apply the locked result mappings.
Validate the complete candidate against that exact order using FOOD-005F. Reject relationship mismatch without a write.

Read the exact confirmation identity privately and authenticate any existing row. Identical authentic content returns already-present; divergent authentic content returns conflict; malformed storage returns storage-failure.
If absent, attempt one parameterized INSERT of the 12 columns with RETURNING the same 12 columns, using the existing FOOD all<T>() convention. Never UPDATE, DELETE, UPSERT or overwrite.

Require exactly one authenticated identical returned row before created. A throw, uncertain envelope, missing/multiple/malformed/mismatched returned rows or uniqueness race triggers one exact identity reread, not another INSERT.

Recovery reread: identical authentic row returns already-present; divergent authentic row returns conflict; absent, malformed, multiple, throwing or unclassifiable durable state returns storage-failure.
Return detached deeply frozen FOOD-005F canonical evidence for successes and frozen result wrappers. Do not expose raw rows, metadata or caller-owned references.

migration.execution: Declarative only in the future implementation unit; never execute this or any other migration as part of authoring/validation work.
constraints: All 12 columns NOT NULL with SQLite TEXT/INTEGER storage-class checks or equivalent STRICT table protections.
Composite PRIMARY KEY (confirmation_id, confirmation_version) with exact binary text identity semantics.
confirmation_version exactly integer 1; order_version integer 1 or 2 as supported by FOOD-008A/008B.
Each currency exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; each money minor_units integer between 0 and 9007199254740991 inclusive; no cross-money equality requirement.

Bounded canonical confirmation ID according to FOOD-005F prefix plus local maximum 128; order ID according to FOOD-005E prefix plus local maximum 128; SQL minimum nonempty/bounded checks supplement, never replace, domain parsers.
processor length 1..128; processor_payment_reference and confirmation_source_reference length 1..512; nonempty canonical bounded text required by application validation.
Composite FOREIGN KEY (order_id, order_version) REFERENCES food_physical_order_versions(order_id, order_version), without update/delete cascades.
BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers abort every attempted mutation. No reference-uniqueness constraint beyond primary confirmation identity.
migration.foreignKeyBoundary: Use the existing FOOD SQLite foreign-key convention and require enforcement on the runtime connection. The FK protects parent existence under enforced constraints; FOOD-008B plus FOOD-005F authenticates exact content/subtotal. Neither replaces the other. No runtime PRAGMA, migration execution, snapshot-parsing SQL or order mutation is added by the adapter.
migration.parentImmutability: The authenticated FOOD-008A parent is append-only and cannot be updated/deleted under its declared schema. No new lifecycle insertion guard beyond version/channel/money/identity/FK constraints is required for this evidence occurrence.

authorityBoundary.safeClaim: A validated FOOD-005F electronic payment confirmation is durably recorded under this exact confirmation identity/version and exact order binding.
authorityBoundary.callerAssertion: Domain validation plus persistence authenticates recorded structure/history, not the truth of the caller's asserted external verification.

allowed: one exact recovery SELECT if needed

requiredFutureTestThemes: Valid version 1 persists as created with all 12 fields retained exactly.
Exact order ID/version, historical subtotal, processor/payment/source references and confirmed amount are retained.
Malformed confirmation ID, unsupported confirmation version and hostile candidate shapes return invalid with zero D1 calls.
Malformed order ID/version, subtotal, processor, processor payment reference, source reference and confirmed money fail closed.
Order not-found maps to conflict; invalid maps to invalid; storage-failure maps to storage-failure; each prevents INSERT.
Candidate/order ID and version mismatch, wrong returned coordinates, and subtotal mismatch cannot persist; distinguish relationship conflict from malformed storage.
Exact cancelled order version 2 accepts evidence without reviving or granting authority.
Confirmed amount may differ from subtotal; independently valid confirmed currency is retained without inventing an equality constraint.
Same identity and exact content returns already-present with no write; valid divergent content returns conflict; malformed existing row returns storage-failure.
Different confirmation identities sharing processor/payment or source reference are not falsely deduplicated; reference uniqueness remains deferred.
Prepare/bind/all failure in a read returns storage-failure; INSERT preparation/bind/execution failure performs at most one recovery read and no write retry.
Uncertain INSERT followed by identical authentic exact row returns already-present; divergent authentic row returns conflict; absent or unauthentic row returns storage-failure.
Malformed response envelopes, row accessors/symbols/custom prototypes, missing/extra columns, duplicates, numeric strings and noncanonical stored values fail closed.
Candidate mutation across await cannot alter the write; returned evidence is detached and deeply frozen.

Migration declaratively contains primary identity, version/channel/money constraints, exact composite order FK and immutable UPDATE/DELETE prevention; static schema assertions must verify the aborting trigger definitions; do not execute the migration in this unit.
No paid-in-full, readiness, reservation, provider-authenticity or cash authority is introduced.
No public read/latest/current/list API, secondary fallback query, mutation of other authorities, provider request or blind retry exists.
Migration 0009 is absent during contract definition and exists only after separately authorized implementation; no migration execution or production access occurs.
